_note: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Keys match the model id case-insensitively; longest prefix wins, so a family entry covers its variants. Modifiers (inference_geo=us 1.1x, service_tier=batch 0.5x, speed=fast 2x) are read from the recorded per-turn usage and applied by viewer/cost.py — do not bake them into these rates. Override the whole file with $DYCRAFT_PRICES_JSON. An unlisted model renders as '--' rather than being guessed.
_source: Claude Opus 5 published API pricing as of 2026-07-28 (released 2026-07-24).
_fable_note: claude-fable-5 is Opus 5's fast tier and bills at 2x the standard rates. It carries its own rate card rather than relying on the speed=fast multiplier, because the recorded per-turn `speed` field reads "standard" on these runs — the 2x is a property of the model id, not a signalled billing mode. Do not set both.
